item.title: Setting up Hermes Agent under Docker with DeepSeek
item.description:
Hermes Agent is an open-source AI agent framework from Nous Research. Unlike a chat interface, it's an operative — the LLM gets a shell, a filesystem, a browser, scheduled cron jobs, and persistent memory across sessions.

The setup: Docker container with persistent volumes, DeepSeek V4 Flash via OpenRouter, custom persona profile (Malenia — named after the Elden Ring boss), and Telegram integration for mobile access.

Key takeaways: start with read-only tools, persist memory for continuity, a well-written persona genuinely changes agent behavior, and always containerize anything with shell access.
